findings.title: Fix the invalid ERB conditional terminator
findings.body: The template closes its conditional with `end if`, leaving a trailing `if` without a condition. This produces invalid Ruby when Rails compiles the ERB template, so requests for an existing embedded topic fail with a template syntax error instead of displaying the discussion. The terminator should be `end`.

findings.title: Preserve HTML sanitization for raw-HTML posts
findings.body: Returning `raw` bypasses HTML sanitization on both creation and subsequent edits. PollFeed passes external feed HTML into TopicEmbed.import without sanitizing it, and Nokogiri fragment parsing does not remove scripts or event handlers. TopicEmbed also appends an attribution link containing an unescaped embed URL after Readability filtering. These values reach `post.cooked` and are rendered with `raw`, allowing stored JavaScript to execute on the forum origin. Skipping Markdown rendering must not skip HTML safety checks.

findings.title: Validate redirect destinations before fetching remote content
findings.body: TopicRetriever checks only the initial URL's host, while open-uri follows redirects here without rechecking the destination. An anonymous embed request pointing to a redirect on the allowed host can therefore make the worker fetch a non-allowlisted host or an internal HTTP resource, whose content may then be imported into a public topic. Validate the scheme and destination of every redirect rather than treating the initial host check as sufficient.

findings.title: Support RSS bodies outside the Atom content field
findings.body: Valid RSS feeds commonly store item bodies in `description` or `content:encoded`, and Atom entries can provide only `summary`. Those entries have no `i.content`, so calling `.scrub` here raises instead of importing them and aborts the rest of the polling run. Select the available body field and handle entries without a body; tests should exercise actual RSS and Atom fixtures rather than only the execute guards.

findings.title: Resolve relative URLs against the complete article URL
findings.body: This conversion treats protocol-relative URLs such as `//cdn.example.com/image.jpg` as local paths, producing a broken URL such as `http://article-host/cdn.example.com/image.jpg`. It also leaves path-relative references such as `images/photo.jpg` and `../other-article` unchanged, so browsers resolve them against the Discourse page rather than the source article. The same problems affect images below. Use URI resolution against the complete article URL for both href and src.

findings.title: Defer post jobs until the outer import transaction commits
findings.body: PostCreator.create enqueues processing and featured-user jobs after its own Post.transaction block, but that transaction joins the outer Topic.transaction opened here. Consequently, those jobs are enqueued before the post and topic are committed, and before the TopicEmbed insertion can fail. Another worker can process rows that are not yet visible, or work for an import that subsequently rolls back. Arrange for these jobs and publication side effects to run only after the outer transaction commits.

findings.title: Update imported content and its hash under one lock
findings.body: The post revision and content_sha1 update are separate operations without a transaction or row lock. Scheduled polling and retrieval-triggered polling can overlap: one import can save body A, another save body B and hash B, then the first write hash A. The stored hash then describes different content from the post, and a subsequent import of A skips a necessary revision because the hashes match. Serialize updates for an embed and commit its post revision and hash together.

findings.title: Set the retrieval throttle and its expiration atomically
findings.body: SETNX and EXPIRE are separate commands. If the worker terminates between them, the retrieval key remains without an expiration. Every later non-staff attempt then sees SETNX fail and refuses to retrieve that URL indefinitely, leaving the embed stuck on the reloading screen. Use an atomic Redis operation that sets the key only when absent and assigns its TTL in the same command.

findings.title: Preserve historical topic timestamps during Disqus imports
findings.body: The previous topic creation passed the exported thread's `created_at`, but TopicEmbed.import_remote has no creation-time option and creates the first post at the current time. Replies still receive their historical timestamps. Importing an old export therefore makes every topic appear newly created and gives its first post a timestamp later than its replies, corrupting discussion history and chronological statistics. Pass the exported creation time through the new import path.

findings.title: Compare message origins exactly rather than by substring
findings.body: The substring check accepts origins that merely prefix the configured forum origin. For example, with `discourseUrl` set to `https://forum.example.com/`, a message from `https://forum.example.co` passes this check. An unrelated frame or window with a reference to the embedding page can then send trusted resize messages and manipulate the comments frame's height. Compare against the parsed origin exactly and verify that the message source is this iframe.
